admission.justification: Four regression tests verify that _JudgedHistoryClosing.restore executes both restores without short-circuiting and returns a boolean matching HistoryClosing.restore so polymorphic callers never skip ignore cleanup or see None.

applicability: Restoration of prepared history and memory-ignore artifacts in worktrees/direct_landing.py::_JudgedHistoryClosing.restore.
conditions: Both the base HistoryClosing preparation and ignore_before preparation are active on a judged closing.
exclusions: Plain HistoryClosing instances that have no ignore_before preparation.
statement: _JudgedHistoryClosing.restore preserves the HistoryClosing.restore boolean contract by running both super().restore() and self.ignore_before.restore() without short-circuiting and returning False if either failed.
title: _JudgedHistoryClosing.restore runs both restores and returns bool
